newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee weakens on dollar, pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee weakens on dollar, pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee continued to weaken against the dollar and pound on Thursday, reflecting international market trends and local market conditions, forex dealers said.
The rupee was posted at a mean commercial rate of 21.5705 to the dollar from 21.5375 on Wednesday and 35.344 against the pound from 35.1055 on Wednesday.
Forex dealers said the weaker rupee reflected a combination of the dollar's strength overnight in international markets and a shortage of hard currency in the local market.
"The central bank sold dollars in the interbank forex market on Wednesday afternoon at five to six cents above the prevailing interbank rate," one dealer said.
He said the shortage of hard currency continued on Thursday morning.
